issues_detected.description: No parent_datasets or related_datasets; prior versions (fairhub.1, fairhub.2) and the controlled-access dataset are not linked with typed relationships.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add related_datasets entries with relationship types (e.g., is version of fairhub.1/fairhub.2; controlled-access counterpart).

issues_detected.description: regulatory_restrictions has only other_compliance (NIH GDS Policy); no confidentiality_level, hipaa_compliant status or governance committee contact, although the record describes HIPAA checks, BAA requirements and a Data Access Committee.
issues_detected.recommendation: State confidentiality_level, hipaa_compliant status and a contact for the Data Access Committee.

issues_detected.description: download_url absent; access steps are described in data_governance prose and only the landing page URL is given.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide the FAIRhub download/access URL in download_url.

issues_detected.description: No variables (data dictionary) or is_tabular flag for a dataset with substantial tabular OMOP/survey data.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a variable-level data dictionary (or a link to it) and set is_tabular for the tabular components.

issues_detected.description: at_risk_populations absent; inclusion of or protections for vulnerable participants (e.g., older adults up to 85, people with cognitive impairment screened by MoCA) are not addressed.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document whether vulnerable populations were included and what protections applied.

issues_detected.description: No software that transformed the released data (format converters to DICOM/OMOP/Open mHealth) is named; only capture (REDCap), validation (OMOP DQD) and hosting (FAIRhub/Azure) tools appear.
issues_detected.recommendation: Name the conversion/mapping software (and versions or repositories) used to produce the DICOM, OMOP and Open mHealth files.

issues_detected.description: imputation_protocols absent and no explicit statement that imputation was not used; cleaning mentions filling missing data from other record portions without a protocol.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add imputation_protocols, or state explicitly that no imputation was performed.

issues_detected.description: is_deidentified.method states no identifiers were collected, while the IRB protocol (per source_caveats) obtains name, MRN, DOB, address and ZIP, and the Nature Metabolism comment describes HIPAA Safe Harbor removal. The record discloses the conflict and scopes the statement to the released data.
issues_detected.recommendation: Clarify that identifiers were held only in internal study records and name the method applied to the release (e.g., Safe Harbor).

issues_detected.description: License grants research, commercial and non-commercial use, while access steps restrict the public version to type 2 diabetes research; the record labels the license both 'AI-READI custom license v2.0' and 'Health Data License'. Disclosed in source_caveats.
issues_detected.recommendation: Reconcile the license's permitted purposes with the T2D-only attestation and use one license name.

issues_detected.description: Aaron Lee and Cecilia Lee are affiliated with Washington University in St. Louis per FAIRhub, while NIH RePORTER lists University of Washington; the conflict is disclosed for Aaron Lee only.
issues_detected.recommendation: Verify and harmonize PI affiliations across sources.

issues_detected.description: Collection start 2023-07-19 (FAIRhub) vs 18 July 2023 (BMJ Open), and v3.0 described as pilot/first-year data in some sources vs 2280 participants through May 2025; disclosed in top-level source_caveats. Temporal order collection (2023-2025) -> release (2025-11-17) is consistent.
issues_detected.recommendation: No action needed beyond the existing disclosure.

semantic_insights: Record is semantically coherent for a multimodal human-subjects T2DM cohort: involves_human_subjects=true is matched by IRB approval, informed consent and a deidentification statement.
Source conflicts (deidentification method, license scope, enrollment dates, PI affiliation, grant-number typo) are disclosed in source_caveats rather than silently resolved.
Main gaps are structural: no variable-level metadata, no typed related datasets, no download_url, no named processing software, no imputation statement.

correctness_validations.url_validity: valid structure (fairhub.io, docs.aireadi.org, doi.org, github.com, clinicaltrials.gov)
